description:
Welcome to team Chronicles! We are a passionate development crew diving into the history of space exploration to build an immersive digital experience. Our focus is on combining robust full-stack web development with compelling UI/UX design to bring NASA's historic, discarded lunar and Martian hardware back to life.

We are currently looking for a creative UX/UI Designer to join our team and help us shape an intuitive, engaging interface targeted at inspiring the next generation of space explorers!
